## MCP Tools API

The read-only query surface behind `mcp/server.mjs`.

**Not on the intake path.** Nothing here runs while a request is being triaged. Intake keeps its own workflow and its own guarantee: if the model is unreachable the row is still stored and escalated. That property is not traded away for richer context.

Every query runs as `triage_ro`, which **cannot write** — enforced by grant in `db/init/03-readonly-role.sql`, not by anything in this workflow.

Fixed queries, never SQL from the model. A small model writing its own SQL is a runaway query on a node that is also triaging.

nodes.name: Run Read-Only Query
nodes.notes: Runs as triage_ro. Cannot write — enforced by GRANT, with a 5s statement_timeout.
